svg.title: The occupancy lattice for the toy example
svg.desc: Left: a heatmap of the occupancy gamma for target ab over five frames, with time left to right and extended-target positions top to bottom. The mass starts on a, passes through the middle blank around frame 2, sits on b at frame 3 and ends on b or the final blank. Right: the same mass added up per class, giving a soft target for each frame, shown above the network's softmax output for comparison.
svg.text: Occupancy = alpha × beta ÷ p(target): the share of the mass passing through each cell. Every frame sums to 1.
ADDED UP PER CLASS: THE SOFT TARGET
The blank row on the right is rows s=0, s=2 and s=4 on the left added together; a is row s=1, b is row s=3.
Gradient for the logits = softmax − soft target. Frame 0, class a: 0.600 − 0.741 = −0.141, so push a up.
